o.text: Internationalism; via Russian акаде́мия (akadémija), ultimately from Ancient Greek Ἀκαδημία (Akadēmía).
From qız- + -ğın. Cognate with Ottoman Turkish قیزغین (kızgın).
From Arabic جَلْب (jalb). Cognate with Turkish celp.
Ultimately borrowed from Turkish başkan. By surface analysis, baş (“head”) + qan (“khan”).
Perhaps from the verb Proto-Turkic *yörge- (“wrap, swathe”); the synonymous çevrə and دكره are derived from verbs meaning to "turn, rotate, topple".
